title: [SMM Steel Market Flash] POSCO Signs 26 MOUs with Customers, Pivoting from Price Competition to Joint Development
dek: POSCO has signed 26 MOUs with customers as it pivots from price competition towards joint development, according to Shanghai Metals Market.
summary: Shanghai Metals Market reports that POSCO has signed 26 memoranda of understanding with customers, describing it as a shift from price competition to joint development. No excerpt was provided, so the customers and sectors involved are not identified.
keyFacts: The move is framed as a pivot from price competition to joint development
whyItMatters: A move towards co-development with customers could reflect efforts by producers to defend margins in a market where competition on price is intense. It suggests a focus on higher-value, tailored products.
implications: Customers in the agreements may gain closer technical collaboration with POSCO. Rival suppliers competing mainly on price could find some accounts harder to win.
